_comment: Walkabout presence-only species lists stated explicitly in the reports (no quadrats). Imported as sightings with frequency_band '+'. Only lists the reports enumerate cleanly are included; scattered prose mentions are not.

tables.method: Walkabout survey of Lark Farm field 0259 after SSSI seed-rich hay strewing, 3 July 2025 (driven in by Nick in the Hi-Sun over the poached ground). Species listed as established from the strewn hay, plus the flowering Creeping Thistle patches.

rows.note: A Somerset Notable; especially pleasing among the hay-strewing recruits
Flowering patches in the less closely grazed parts, drawing bees, hoverflies and butterflies

tables.method: Walkabout observations of the sown garden bank (plot C), first recorded in 2026; 'just one mass of flowers'.
tables.source: Annual Monitoring Report 2026, section 4.2 and photos 41-44

rows.note: Predominating with Red Clover across the bank
Predominating with White Clover across the bank

tables.method: Preliminary recces of West End Wood (West), 27 April and 7 September 2021; herbaceous flora noted outside the conifer blocks. Far from a comprehensive survey (the report's words).

tables.source: Annual Monitoring Report 2023, section 3.3 and Appendix III
